name: Loco Dice at Honi Beach Club
description: Head to the coast for a night of tech house and house music from the legendary DJ Loco Dice at this popular beach club.
longDescription:
On June 13, 2026, Honi Beach Club hosts Loco Dice, the German DJ and producer known for his contributions to the tech house and house music genres. With a career spanning decades, Loco Dice has released music on labels such as M_nus and Desolat, the latter of which he founded. His sets are characterized by a blend of percussive rhythms and deep basslines, drawing from his diverse musical influences.

Attendees can expect an evening dedicated to electronic music, set against the backdrop of the beach club. The event is categorized as nightlife, suggesting a late-night duration. The open-air setting of Honi Beach Club provides an environment for dancing and socializing, with the sound of the ocean nearby. The audience typically consists of individuals interested in contemporary electronic music and club culture.

Tickets are required for entry to this event. Specific details regarding purchase points or potential for quick sell-out are not available. Honi Beach Club is located on the coast, outside the immediate city center of Porto. Transportation options would likely include private car or ride-sharing services, as direct metro or tram access is not typical for beach club locations.
